text:
Asha Patel: Quick pulse — noticed our webinar -> inbound conversion rate dropped 18% week-over-week after last week's routing tweak. Putting this here so we can triage in one thread. Link to dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/kpis/webinars (see conversions widget)
Matt R.: ah — which tweak? the split to SDR pool B or the new utm param change?
Asha Patel: SDR pool B routing was enabled Wed 09:10, and we also changed the landing page utm to `utm_campaign=webinar_apr` (removed `utm_source=ad`) on the same deploy.
Lina Gomez: can you paste the cohort SQL? I want to see the raw lead counts vs attributed ones.
Asha Patel: sure — pulling the snippet from the docs:

```sql
SELECT sent_at::date, count(*) as leads, sum(converted::int) as conversions
FROM inbound.leads
WHERE campaign LIKE '%webinar_apr%'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC
LIMIT 14;
```

It looks like raw leads are flat, conversions down.
Jordan (ops): metrics-bot, can you run conversion funnel for last 14 days and show utm_source breakdown?
metrics-bot: run started — funnel id: f_7781. Results will be posted in 30s.
metrics-bot: results: total leads 1,240 (14d), conversions 184 (14d), overall conv rate 14.8% (was 18.1% prior period). top utm_source: organic (42%), campaign:webinar_apr (33%), partners (8%) — note 12% of leads have empty utm fields.
Priya Sen: empty utm fields jumped from 6% -> 12% after the landing change? that smells like a tracking drop.
Matt R.: could be the redirect we added on the landing — I remember we removed a query param merge in the CDN rules.
Lina Gomez: if tracking is missing, attribution will undercount. But conversions down even on known-utm leads? need split.
Asha Patel: good call — matt can you revert the redirect rule on staging and we can run a small live test? also can someone look at the SDR pool B performance? maybe lead quality shifted.
Matt R.: I'll revert the CDN rule in staging now, will ping when done. Also pulling SDR B lead quality metrics.
metrics-bot: SDR B raw metrics (7d): contacted 86, demo-booked 9 (10.5%), demo->opp rate 44% — slightly lower than SDR A but not enough to explain -18% conv overall.
Jordan (ops): ops note: routing change also changed email templates used for initial outreach (we pointed pool B at template v5). Could be messaging mismatch.
Priya Sen: do we have a quick AB on email templates? if v5 is underperforming we should revert to v4 ASAP.
Asha Patel: action list:
- Matt revert CDN redirect on staging + test tracking (Matt)
- Priya run quick AB on email v4 vs v5 for next 120 leads (Priya)
- Lina run funnel breakouts for known-utm vs empty-utm and per-SDR-pool (Lina)
- Jordan monitor rollback impact & holdoff on further routing changes (Jordan)

Can folks ack and add ETA here?
Matt R.: ack — will revert + test in 30m.
Priya Sen: ack — AB queued, ETA results ~24-36h but will push earlier if signal strong.
Lina Gomez: ack — running queries now, will post short summary in ~1h.
Jordan (ops): ack — monitoring, will post if any regressions show up in the live dashboard.
Asha Patel: thanks — if tracking fix shows baseline returns we will treat this as attribution noise. If not, we'll escalate to messaging and SDR coaching. :thumbsup:
Matt R.: staging redirect reverted, test clicks show utm preserved. Will coordinate a tiny live test at 11:15.
Lina Gomez: initial splits: known-utm conv 17.9% (prior 18.6%), empty-utm conv 6.2% (prior 11.9%) — biggest hit is the empty-utm cohort. Full query + csv attached to the docs page.
Priya Sen: that's confirming tracking loss is main driver. I'll pause AB and prep a cleanup email to backward-fill param for recent signups via tracking pixel where possible.
Asha Patel: perfect — close loop after the 11:15 live test and report back in morning sync. Thanks everyone.
